error[ZBX-E0104]: can't mount overlayfs in a user namespace
  cause  the namespaces were created but mount(overlay) was refused: the overlay
         module may be missing or not loaded, or a security policy forbids the
         mount
  fix    load the overlay module:   sudo modprobe overlay
         or use Linux 5.11 or newer built with CONFIG_OVERLAY_FS
  more   zbx explain E0104 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0104.html
